specialists.capability: Reveals exact immediate contacts and improves informed route safety.
specialists.limitation: Requires Crew Quarters, 12 Ashmarks of supplies, and the fortress's only specialist berth.
specialists.conflict_or_promise: At Morrowline, retain exact forecasts or leave Iven with the relay crews so Mara can take the berth.
specialists.visible_consequence: Route dossiers name exact contacts while assigned; the Morrowline choice and Debrief record whether forecast certainty was kept.

specialists.capability: A Ready Field Workshop restores one additional durability for the same service price.
specialists.limitation: Her repair bonus stops when the crew-connected Field Workshop is offline and she occupies the only berth.
specialists.conflict_or_promise: Commit one forge core to a damaged system or the Refugee Bunk, then test that promise on the fourth road.
specialists.visible_consequence: The recovery receipt names her bonus and What Held records success or failure in Debrief.

specialists.capability: Run Hot saves one day and enables a feint against scouts and Signal Hunters.
specialists.limitation: Requires a Ready crew-connected Command Deck; Run Hot adds four route-risk points.
specialists.conflict_or_promise: Choose schedule over safety and keep the staffed command chain intact.
specialists.visible_consequence: The route receipt shows one fewer day and four more risk points; applicable contacts name Sela's feint.

specialists.capability: Reduces damage to crew and refuge compartments by one.
specialists.limitation: Requires a Ready crew-connected Field Infirmary and contributes no attack.
specialists.conflict_or_promise: Reserve scarce chassis capacity for people instead of command acceleration or firepower.
specialists.visible_consequence: Contact receipts attribute Nera's triage when a crew or refuge target takes reduced damage.

specialists.capability: Long roads cost one less fuel.
specialists.limitation: Requires a Ready engine and adds one heat to the route forecast.
specialists.conflict_or_promise: Trade thermal margin for a longer fuel line across the Cinder Spine.
specialists.visible_consequence: Route dossiers show both the one-fuel saving and one-heat cost before commitment.

specialists.capability: Reduces Lift Saboteur damage by one.
specialists.limitation: Requires a Ready crew-connected Field Workshop and affects no other threat family.
specialists.conflict_or_promise: Keep workshop rigging available for sabotage instead of using the berth for route, medical, or fuel expertise.
specialists.visible_consequence: The impact profile attributes Tomas's rigging when it reduces a Lift Saboteur hit.

obligations.later_change: Evacuation Camp gains one service action.
Sunken Tramworks gains one less pressure.
Pump Gallery risk falls by six points.

replay_comparisons.second: stronger workshop recovery and a forge-core callback
